newsitem.title: USA: Anadigics files to offer shares.
newsitem.headline: Anadigics files to offer shares.

text.p: Anadigics Inc said Friday it filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission with respect to a proposed stock offering of up to 2,347,739 shares of common stock.
The company said it expects to offer 1,875,000 shares and 166,513 shares are expected to be offered by selling stockholders.
In connection with the proposed common stock offering, Anadigics said it has granted the underwriters an over- allotment option to purchase up to an additional 306,226 newly-issued shares.
The company said Goldman, Sachs & Co will be the lead manager, and Oppenheimer & Co Inc and Needham & Company Inc will be acting as co-managers in the proposed offering.

Anadigics said it will use about $50 million of its net proceeds to purchase capital equipment and make leasehold improvements, and will use the remainder of the proceeds for general corporate purposes, including working capital.
The company said it will receive no proceeds from the sale of shares of common stock by the selling shareholders.
Anadigics said the number of shares being offered reflects a three-for-two stock split payable February 20 to holders of record on February 10.
